authority.request: 我希望CLI也包含快速刪除功能  專職於超高速單或批量文件目錄清理 並書寫一個README_AI.md 另外希望還能借鑑steam刪除的方法讓被刪除的空間更快的被列為可用

relationship_to_original_57: Add CLI quick namespace deletion and space observation to the previously authorized quick mode; preserve original overwrite requirements, protection and testing responsibility. The earlier RC3 GUI-only statement is historical.

requirements.text: Expose quick permanent deletion in the CLI for explicit single or mixed file/directory roots after --; preserve the original overwrite commands.

Without confirmation quick only prepares an inert in-session preview. With --confirm-irreversible freeze roots once and execute that exact in-session fingerprint; no persisted quick job or cross-process resume.
Share frozen membership, system/reparse protection, identity checks and failure-last access/graceful-close recovery. Noninteractive quick never authorizes force termination.
Emit compact JSONL quick summaries and failed/pending target details by default; --show-paths emits all targets and paths. Preserve explicit nonzero partial/execution/output exits and protected logs.

Prefer larger observed allocation first among pending first-pass files with bounded workers, then child-first directories. Allocation is a fingerprint-bound scheduling hint, not identity or reclaimable-byte evidence.

Observe at most 128 prepared eligible volume GUID roots before/after quick execution using read-only current-principal space counters. Distinguish quota-available and total-free counters; failures are diagnostic and deltas are not attributed to this job.
Provide README_AI.md with exact CLI contract, automation examples, result/exit handling, limits, build requirements and evidence boundaries. The explicitly requested filename is retained.

Preserve source RC/native-test responsibility gates and module architecture. Do not claim an undocumented Steam algorithm or guaranteed immediate capacity; do not truncate shared contents or issue raw device reclaim commands.

research_boundary: Valve official install-script and SteamPipe documentation do not publish a client uninstall allocation-release algorithm. Largest-allocation-first is this project scheduling heuristic, not a verified Steam implementation.
